tool_schemas.name: get_latest_result
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent successful execution result for the given Dune query as a CSV payload (format defaults to csv and no other formats are accepted). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query_id is missing/invalid or if an unsupported format is provided, NOT_FOUND if the query does not exist or has no successful execution result yet, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to access the query. May also raise RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded and INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected backend failures.

query_id.description: Internal query id (queries.id) to fetch the most recent successful result for.

format.description: Desired result format; only csv is supported.

tool_schemas.name: run_query
tool_schemas.description: Triggers an execution of the given Dune query and returns the resulting dataset as a CSV payload when the execution completes; if force_refresh is false, an existing cached result may be returned instead of starting a new upstream run. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if query_id is missing/invalid or if an unsupported format is provided, NOT_FOUND if the query does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not allowed to run or read the query. May raise CONFLICT if a new execution cannot be started due to an incompatible in-progress/locked state, RATE_LIMITED when execution or request quotas are exceeded, and INTERNAL_ERROR for unexpected backend failures.

force_refresh.description: If true, bypass cached results (cache_ttl_seconds) and trigger a new upstream execution.

format.description: Desired output format for the created result; only csv is supported.

tool_schemas.name: list_queries
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored query definitions visible to the calling API key, optionally filtered by status or upstream Dune query id. Returns a paginated list ordered by updated_at descending. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the calling key is revoked or lacks scope to read queries.

api_key.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate this request.

dune_query_id.description: Filter by upstream Dune query id (queries.dune_query_id).

limit.description: Maximum number of queries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_query
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single stored query definition by internal id. Returns the query record. Raises NOT_FOUND if the query does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the calling key is revoked or lacks access to the query.

api_key.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate this request.

tool_schemas.name: create_query
tool_schemas.description: Creates a stored query definition that points at an upstream Dune query id. Returns the created query record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR on invalid fields, CONFLICT if a non-deleted query already exists for the same dune_query_id, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the calling key is revoked or lacks permission to create queries.

api_key.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate this request.

dune_query_id.description: Upstream Dune query id to store and execute.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the stored query.

description.description: Optional description of what the query returns.

default_output_format.description: Default output format; only csv is supported.

cache_ttl_seconds.description: Cache TTL in seconds; when > 0, run_query may return a recent succeeded result within TTL without creating a new execution.

tool_schemas.name: update_query
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of a stored query definition and may transition its lifecycle status (active/disabled/deleted) according to allowed transitions. Returns the updated query record. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid updates, CONFLICT if attempting an illegal status transition, NOT_FOUND if the query does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the calling key is revoked or lacks write access.

api_key.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate this request.

default_output_format.description: Default output format; only csv is supported.

status.description: Lifecycle status update. Allowed transitions: active→disabled/deleted; disabled→active/deleted; deleted is terminal.

tool_schemas.name: list_query_executions
tool_schemas.description: Lists executions for a stored query, newest first. Returns a paginated list of query_executions records. Raises NOT_FOUND if the query does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the calling key is revoked or lacks access.

api_key.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate this request.

query_id.description: Internal query id (queries.id) to list executions for.

limit.description: Maximum number of executions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: get_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity for the provided API key, including key metadata, effective scopes, and current rate-limit/quota status for the current window. Refuses with UNAUTHORIZED if the key is missing/invalid, and FORBIDDEN if the key is revoked.

api_key.description: Bearer API key used to authenticate this request.
